title: Extraction log, call detail and rescan jobs

ExtractionOutcome.description: `identity_leak`: the provider-boundary scanner refused the request (pseudonymization on; nothing was sent). `unknown`: a v4-imported call that maps to no other outcome (never a filter the PWA offers).

reasoning_tokens.description: Sum over reporting attempts; null when none reported. Additive, optional for older clients/fixtures.

prompt_tokens.description: Provider-reported prompt tokens summed over the call's attempts that reported a pair; null when none did. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

completion_tokens.description: As `prompt_tokens`, for completion tokens; the pair is all-or-nothing.

summary.description: Per model over the listed (filtered) calls. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

Extraction.description: ExtractionRow without the `messages`/`changes` counts, plus the call itself.

reasoning_content.description: Response-only text from attempts in order, joined with two newlines; at most 64 KiB including a visible truncation marker. Never sent in later requests.

reasoning_tokens.description: Sum over attempts that reported reasoning tokens; null when none reported.

prompt_tokens.description: Provider-reported prompt tokens summed over the call's attempts that reported a pair; null when none did. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

completion_tokens.description: As `prompt_tokens`, for completion tokens; the pair is all-or-nothing.

prompt_estimate.description: The local prompt estimate over the attempts that reported usage, else over every sent attempt; null when nothing was sent. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

context.description: The context the call was budgeted for (logged `guardrail.context`); null for calls logged without one. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

author_id.description: Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

refusals.description: A7, additive (the Rust server always sends it): changes the scheduler refused to stage for this call.

TokenCount.description: A provider-reported or estimated token count; null = not reported (older rows, v4 imports, failed or cut calls), never 0 for unknown.

prompt_tokens.description: Sum over this model's calls that reported a pair; null when none did.

reported.description: Calls that reported a usage pair.

est_ratio.description: Median of reported prompt tokens / prompt estimate over the calls with both (estimate > 0), rounded to two decimals (mean of the two middle values for an even count); null when none.

window.description: `24h`/`48h`: a job the bot or `/rescan` started (never sent by the PWA).

started_at.description: Additive: when the runner took the job (UTC `Z`); null while it is queued.

messages.description: Additive: the channels' `messages`, i.e. gated messages read so far.

messages_total.description: Additive: `messages` plus, for each channel not yet read, its gated messages in the window as cached when the job started. A finished job's total is its `messages`. Null while a channel still to be read has no count (a queued job, or a count that failed).

messages.description: Gated messages this channel's read found (0 until it is `done`, and for a channel that could not be read).

unread.description: A7, additive: messages never read (the model kept turning the rescan away).

errors.description: A7, additive: fixed sentences, never backend text.

unread.description: A7, additive: the channels' unread messages.
